title: Book Downloader
summary: A Python application for searching and downloading eBooks from Library Genesis, converting them to PDF via Calibre. The dependency list includes an unrelated conda package path that superficially matched an SDV search pattern, but there is no genuine connection to SDV or its family.
evidence: requirements.txt: more-itertools @ file:///.../abs_e2687gwsdv/... -- 'sdv' appears only inside an unrelated conda build path
needs: confirm no actual SDV usage exists; pattern hit is a false positive from a filesystem path substring
